newsitem.title: JAPAN: IMF PREPARING FOR TOKYO THAI TALKS NEXT WEEK--MOF.
newsitem.headline: IMF PREPARING FOR TOKYO THAI TALKS NEXT WEEK--MOF.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is preparing to hold a meeting in Tokyo as early as the beginning of next week to discuss an international support package for Thailand, Japanese Vice Finance Minister Takeshi Komura told reporters on Thursday.
"The IMF is making preparations aimed at holding a meeting (about a Thai rescue package) in Tokyo as early as the beginning of next week," Komura said.
Komura said that the participants of the meeting had not yet been decided, but added that he hoped officials of many Asian nations would take part.
